The chore plan has been created.

**Plan file created:** `specs/chore-63ee573e-add-missing-kb-attributes.md`

This chore adds three missing Knowledge Base attributes to the product data model:

1. **`cnySuitable`** (ThaiContext) - Chinese New Year suitability based on color rules from KB Section 12
2. **`silhouetteFit`** (VisualMatching) - 7-value fit classification from KB Section 15
3. **`silhouetteVolume`** (VisualMatching) - Low/medium/high volume derived from fit

The plan includes:
- Adding 3 new enum types to `enums.ts`
- Updating interfaces in `thai-context-types.ts` and `ai-matching-types.ts`
- Updating all 14 products in `mock-data04.ts` with appropriate values
- Validation commands to verify completion
